pages.text: Spawn altars can consume War spirits to spawn mobs.$(br2)A spawn altar must be activated by using it on a spawner. The altar will then become a hallow for War spirits and absorb the spawner's mob type, breaking the spawner.

When placed, a spawn altar can absorb War spirits just like any other hallow (either from other hallows or by directly breaking down items).$(br2)After absorbing War spirits, a Spawn altar will try to spawn mobs of its assigned type, spending one War spirit per HP of the mob spawned.
